title: Expected Configuration Bits
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$, and choose a bounded input-head position and a bounded work-head position for each tape. Given a machine action and a Boolean assignment to the codec ports, the expected value of each encoded bit is defined as follows: input bits copy the old bit; the input-head and state bits indicate whether their indices or states match the action's resulting position or successor state; work-symbol bits copy the old bit except at the scanned cell, where they indicate whether the action writes that symbol; work-head bits indicate whether the head moves to that cell; and summary bits indicate whether the updated output summary is accepting or dead.
